# TruCore

> Open-source infrastructure for the agent economy. Transaction firewalls and trust-graph service registries — MIT-licensed, built for production. Every product ships as a single Go binary an AI agent can install and drive directly.

## Install
- [TruCore Home](https://trucore.xyz): Main landing page with all products.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/trucore-ai): All repositories under trucore-ai organization.

## Products
- [ATF](https://trucore.xyz/docs): Agent Transaction Firewall — policy-enforced guardrails for autonomous agent transactions. Solana-first. Install: `npm i -g @trucore/atf` then `atf trade`.
- [ProvenGraph](https://provengraph.trucore.xyz): The provenance graph for the agent economy. Three product lines: **Trust** (server trust scores with outcome-weighted reputation), **Knowledge** (grounded, verifiable claims), and **Memory** (compliant episodic recall for agents). Install: `go install github.com/trucore-ai/provengraph/cmd/meshdns@latest`.

## Documentation
- [ATF Docs](https://trucore.xyz/docs): Full documentation — CLI reference, policy model, receipt verification, getting started.
- [ProvenGraph Docs](https://trucore.xyz/docs/provengraph): Architecture, Trust/Knowledge/Memory product lines, API reference, SDK quickstart, trust scoring model.

## Optional
- [Builders](https://trucore.xyz/builders): For developers building on TruCore infrastructure.
- [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/trucore-ai): Community discussions and roadmap.
